label: V6.4.128 - DESKTOP LAYOUT
notes: Dedicated desktop UI instead of stretching the mobile layout: permanent left sidebar on desktop Home, centered max-width workspace, multi-column My Flight cards, desktop-sized dialogs and a compact top/right form command bar. Mobile layout and the V6.4.127 restored form dock / no-CHUYẾN / confirm-open behavior remain unchanged.
message: V6.4.128: giao diện PC riêng, không kéo giãn giao diện mobile; giữ nguyên mobile và các sửa lỗi V6.4.127.
